searchText: where do we document rlp notation conventions used in EIPs? i.e. defining what symbols like `||` vs `++` mean in byte strings? Heh are you also looking at https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9248 ? 🙂 Was wondering about this as well. But in the EIP itself the ` || ` is used elsewhere so I guess it is more consistent now by using the same concat op I am, and was also assuming concat but it seems like tablestakes to have that defined and linkable from the EIP header. if there is a source i'm happy to open a pr for that
